annotations.title: Copy a trader, in simulation or live

description: Start a background process that copies a trader for some days: every order of theirs is mirrored, sized as asked, with the real fees; what the leader reduces is reduced by the same share. In simulation by default, on a simulation account of its own, and nothing is signed. With live, the orders go to the real account through the guardian, each checked against the policy and the mandate the user signed on their phone. The process outlives this call and keeps running after the terminal closes, until copy_stop or the days run out.

at_end.description: What becomes of its positions when the days run out: keep (the default, left as they are) or close (closed at market, reduce-only); copy_stop keeps them either way

days.description: How long it copies (default 7, at most 30)

fixed_margin.description: With fixed: the USD of margin for each opening, at most the budget

live.description: On the real account instead of simulation: needs the guardian unlocked by the user and a mandate they signed naming this trader, with room in its copy budget

max_scale.description: With proportional: at most this many times the leader's size (default 1)

percent.description: With percent: the share of the copy's equity used as the margin of each opening

sizing.description: How each opening is sized: proportional (the default: the leader's size times the copy's equity over the leader's, at most max_scale times the leader's size), mirror (the leader's size), percent (that share of the copy's equity as margin), fixed (fixed_margin USD of margin)
